scope: Fresh full physical trials from reset; experimental and uncalibrated, not training certification
model_parameter_selection: Frozen-contact rigid-rotation hypothesis needs about 17.5 N at 42 degrees; test 25 N cap and higher fixed gain to avoid aperture-dependent loss of preload. Not a hardware torque-to-force calibration.
thin_item_policy: 10x lower distance preload budgets with 10x higher kp retains nominal 0.3 N spring preload; actual force and motion must be checked.
